title: Sonauto: Create hit songs with AI | Y Combinator
notes: YC W24 company profile. Sonauto (now Treblo), founded 2023, San Francisco, team of 4, partner Jared Friedman. Founders: Ryan Tremblay (Founder/Chief ML Alchemist) + Hayden Housen (Co-Founder). 'Sonauto is training a music foundation model... We're calling it Melodia.' Self-made model (Melodia). This is the model behind Fenix Flexin's 'Rubberz' (149). treblo.com/about: 'We are a frontier audio AI lab. Four people building you a new relationship with music.'
